spec_notes: Uses 'yaml' package (modern YAML 1.2 parser) and '@iarna/toml' (TOML serializer). Both are pure JS, no native dependencies. Handles nested objects, arrays, and all YAML scalar types. Note: @iarna/toml formats numbers with underscores (e.g., 3_000) which is valid TOML but may differ from other formatters. If strict TOML compliance without underscores is needed, post-process the output string.
